sample_unit: post-implementation rehabilitation discharge summaries (documentation time); 18 therapists for SUS; 11 summaries for hallucination review
models_evaluated: commercial generative AI service with in-house Excel/VBA macro transcription system

links.outcome: Hallucinations and omissions in AI-generated rehabilitation discharge summaries rated by two raters
links.effect: 9 of 11 summaries (81.8%) contained at least one error; 19 hallucinations and 1 omission; major errors 52.6% (10/19); fabrication-type hallucinations major rate 83.3% (5/6).
links.quote: In the hallucination and omission evaluation, 9 of 11 rehabilitation discharge summaries (81.8%) contained at least one error, yielding a total of 19 hallucinations and 1 omission.

links.outcome: Local assessment of AI documentation accuracy, usability, and time savings after deployment
links.effect: Documentation time fell from median 23.0 to 10.0 minutes (-12.26 min, p<0.001); median SUS 83.75; but 81.8% of summaries contained at least one error.
links.quote: The adjusted linear mixed-effects model revealed a significant reduction of 12.26 minutes (95% CI: -15.71 to -8.81; p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Risk-stratified review of high-risk content segments (e.g., fabrication-prone sections) within AI-generated discharge summaries

screen.reason: Evaluates a real-world implementation of a generative AI workflow for rehabilitation discharge summaries, assessing documentation time, usability, and hallucination rates.
